request.prompt: Restrained crisp 16-bit pixel art sprite for a professional New York office in an overhead 2D exploration RPG. High ORTHOGRAPHIC camera looking down 50 degrees, ZERO horizontal camera yaw. All main vertical edges perfectly vertical, all front top and bottom edges perfectly horizontal. NO diagonal silhouette edges, no isometric side view, no vanishing point. Naturally foreshortened front face: its projected height is about 1.30 times its width. A visible narrow horizontal top surface belongs to the slab itself. Small black lever on left with a horizontally flattened elliptical rosette, two modest hinge barrels on right with visible oval top ends: all hardware supports the same high camera. Ivory painted slab, restrained dark outlines, visible hard square pixel clusters, warm gray shading, no photoreal gradients. Object centered with generous empty margins on uniform opaque magenta #ff00ff. No text, no floor, no surrounding wall, no cast shadow. Make ONE COMPLETE front-facing CLOSED doorway assembly, including ivory door leaf INSIDE a narrow warm-walnut fixed frame: left jamb, right jamb, horizontal lintel and thin bottom sill. Frame modest and snug, no external arch, no tall ornament. Entire assembly short broad upright rectangular silhouette, outer height about 1.4 times width. Door fully shut flush inside frame. Show subtle frame top surface from above. This is for a NORTH or SOUTH wall, not a side-wall open door.

admission.reason: Front too tall; hardware frontal and weak foreshortening. No runtime admission.
